\begin{matrix} R_{\sigma_{3}}(2s(p))B|j\rangle & =e^{-is(p)}\sum_{k\in\mathcal{C}}B_{2k,j}|k\rangle|0\rangle+e^{is(p)}\sum_{k\in\mathcal{C}}B_{2k+1,j}|k\rangle|1\rangle+\sum_{k\notin\mathcal{C}}(B_{2k,j}|k\rangle|0\rangle+B_{2k+1,j}|k\rangle|1\rangle) \\  & =e^{-is(p)}|{\overset{\sim}{b}}^{j}\rangle+e^{is(p)}|{\overset{\sim}{a}}^{j}\rangle+|{\overset{\sim}{c}}^{j}\rangle, \end{matrix}
